text: Monge sindon geond middangeard unrīmu cynn, þāra þe wē æþelu ne magon ryhte āreccan nē rīm witan; þæs wīde sind geond woruld innan fugla and dēora foldhrērendras, wornas widsceope, swā wæter bibūgeð þisne beorhtan bōsm, brim grymetende, sealtȳpa geswing.
text_bare: Monge sindon geond middangeard unrimu cynn, þara þe we æþelu ne magon ryhte areccan ne rim witan; þæs wide sind geond woruld innan fugla and deora foldhrerendras, wornas widsceope, swa wæter bibugeð þisne beorhtan bosm, brim grymetende, sealtypa geswing.

text: Wē bi sumum hȳrdon wrǣtlīcum gecynde wildra secgan, fīrum frēamǣrne, feorlondum on, eard weardian, ēðles nēotan, æfter dūnscrafum.
text_bare: We bi sumum hyrdon wrætlicum gecynde wildra secgan, firum freamærne, feorlondum on, eard weardian, eðles neotan, æfter dunscrafum.

text: Is þæt dēor Pandher bi noman hāten, þæs þe niþþa bearn,
text_bare: Is þæt deor Pandher bi noman haten, þæs þe niþþa bearn,

text: wīsfæste weras, on gewritum cȳþað bi þām ānstapan.
text_bare: wisfæste weras, on gewritum cyþað bi þam anstapan.

text: Sē is ǣghwām frēond, duguða ēstig, būtan dracan ānum; þām hē in ealle tīd andwrāð leofaþ, þurh yfla gehwylc þe hē geæfnan mæg.
text_bare: Se is æghwam freond, duguða estig, butan dracan anum; þam he in ealle tid andwrað leofaþ, þurh yfla gehwylc þe he geæfnan mæg.

text: Ðæt is wrǣtlīc dēor, wundrum scȳne, hīwa gehwylces.
text_bare: Ðæt is wrætlic deor, wundrum scyne, hiwa gehwylces.

text: Swā hæleð secgað, gǣsthālge guman, þætte Iōsēphes tunece wǣre telga gehwylces blēom bregdende, þāra beorhtra gehwylc, ǣghwæs ǣnlīcra, ōþrum līxte dryhta bearnum, swā þæs dēores hīw, blǣc, brigda gehwæs, beorhtra and scȳnra wundrum līxeð, þætte wrǣtlīcra ǣghwylc ōþrum, ǣnlīcra gīen and fǣgerra, frætwum blīceð, symle sellīcra.
text_bare: Swa hæleð secgað, gæsthalge guman, þætte Iosephes tunece wære telga gehwylces bleom bregdende, þara beorhtra gehwylc, æghwæs ænlicra, oþrum lixte dryhta bearnum, swa þæs deores hiw, blæc, brigda gehwæs, beorhtra and scynra wundrum lixeð, þætte wrætlicra æghwylc oþrum, ænlicra gien and fægerra, frætwum bliceð, symle sellicra.

text: Hē hafað sundorgecynd,
text_bare: He hafað sundorgecynd,

text: milde, gemetfæst.
text_bare: milde, gemetfæst.

text: Hē is monþwǣre, lufsum and lēoftæl: nele lāþes wiht ǣngum geæfnan būtan þām āttorsceaþan, his fyrngeflitan, þe ic ǣr fore sægde.
text_bare: He is monþwære, lufsum and leoftæl: nele laþes wiht ængum geæfnan butan þam attorsceaþan, his fyrngeflitan, þe ic ær fore sægde.

text: Symle, fylle fægen, þonne fōddor þigeð, æfter þām gereordum ræste sēceð, dȳgle stōwe under dūnscrafum; ðǣr se þēodwiga þrēonihta fæc swifeð on sweofote, slǣpe gebiesgad.
text_bare: Symle, fylle fægen, þonne foddor þigeð, æfter þam gereordum ræste seceð, dygle stowe under dunscrafum; ðær se þeodwiga þreonihta fæc swifeð on sweofote, slæpe gebiesgad.

text: Þonne ellenrōf ūp āstondeð, þrymme gewelgad, on þone þriddan dæg, snēome of slǣpe.
text_bare: Þonne ellenrof up astondeð, þrymme gewelgad, on þone þriddan dæg, sneome of slæpe.

text: Swēghlēoþor cymeð, wōþa wynsumast, þurh þæs wildres mūð; æfter pære stefne stenc ūt cymeð of þām wongstede— wynsumra stēam, swēttra and swīþra, swæcca gehwylcum, wyrta blōstmum and wudublēdum, eallum æþelīcra eorþan frætwum.
text_bare: Sweghleoþor cymeð, woþa wynsumast, þurh þæs wildres muð; æfter pære stefne stenc ut cymeð of þam wongstede— wynsumra steam, swettra and swiþra, swæcca gehwylcum, wyrta blostmum and wudubledum, eallum æþelicra eorþan frætwum.

text: Þonne of ceastrum and cynestōlum and of burgsalum beornþrēat monig farað foldwegum folca þrȳþum; ēoredcystum, ofestum gefȳsde, dareðlācende —dēor swā some— æfter þǣre stefne on þone stenc farað.
text_bare: Þonne of ceastrum and cynestolum and of burgsalum beornþreat monig farað foldwegum folca þryþum; eoredcystum, ofestum gefysde, dareðlacende —deor swa some— æfter þære stefne on þone stenc farað.

text: Swā is Dryhten God, drēama Rǣdend, eallum ēaðmēde ōþrum gesceaftum, duguða gehwylcre, būtan dracan ānum, āttres ordfruman— þæt is se ealda fēond þone hē gesǣlde in sūsla grund, and gefetrade fȳrnum tēagum, biþeahte þrēanȳdum; and þȳ þriddan dæge of dīgle ārās, þæs þe hē dēað fore ūs þrēo niht þolade, Þēoden engla, sigora Sellend.
text_bare: Swa is Dryhten God, dreama Rædend, eallum eaðmede oþrum gesceaftum, duguða gehwylcre, butan dracan anum, attres ordfruman— þæt is se ealda feond þone he gesælde in susla grund, and gefetrade fyrnum teagum, biþeahte þreanydum; and þy þriddan dæge of digle aras, þæs þe he deað fore us þreo niht þolade, Þeoden engla, sigora Sellend.

text: Þæt wæs swēte stenc, wlitig and wynsum, geond woruld ealle.
text_bare: Þæt wæs swete stenc, wlitig and wynsum, geond woruld ealle.

text: Siþþan tō þām swicce sōðfæste men,
text_bare: Siþþan to þam swicce soðfæste men,

text: on healfa gehwone, hēapum þrungon geond ealne ymbhwyrft eorþan scēata.
text_bare: on healfa gehwone, heapum þrungon geond ealne ymbhwyrft eorþan sceata.

text: Swā se snottra gecwæð Sanctus Paulus: ‘Monigfealde sind geond middangeard gōd ungnȳðe þe ūs tō giefe dǣleð and tō feorhnere Fæder ælmihtig, and se ānga Hyht ealra gesceafta uppe ge niþre.’ Þæt is æþele stenc.
text_bare: Swa se snottra gecwæð Sanctus Paulus: ‘Monigfealde sind geond middangeard god ungnyðe þe us to giefe dæleð and to feorhnere Fæder ælmihtig, and se anga Hyht ealra gesceafta uppe ge niþre.’ Þæt is æþele stenc.

text: Nū ic fitte gēn ymb fisca cynn wille wōðcræfte wordum cȳþan þurh mōdgemynd, bi þām miclan hwale.
text_bare: Nu ic fitte gen ymb fisca cynn wille woðcræfte wordum cyþan þurh modgemynd, bi þam miclan hwale.

text: Sē bið unwillum oft gemēted, frēcne and ferhðgrim, fareðlācendum, niþþa gehwylcum; þām is noma cenned, fyrgenstrēama geflotan, Fastitocalon.
text_bare: Se bið unwillum oft gemeted, frecne and ferhðgrim, fareðlacendum, niþþa gehwylcum; þam is noma cenned, fyrgenstreama geflotan, Fastitocalon.

text: Is þæs hīw gelīc hrēofum stāne, swylce wōrie bi wædes ōfre, sondbeorgum ymbseald, sǣrȳrica mǣst, swā þæt wēnaþ wǣglīþende þæt hȳ on ēalond sum ēagum wlīten; and þonne gehȳdiað hēahstefn scipu tō þām unlonde oncyrrāpum, sǣlaþ sǣmearas sundes æt ende,
text_bare: Is þæs hiw gelic hreofum stane, swylce worie bi wædes ofre, sondbeorgum ymbseald, særyrica mæst, swa þæt wenaþ wægliþende þæt hy on ealond sum eagum wliten; and þonne gehydiað heahstefn scipu to þam unlonde oncyrrapum, sælaþ sæmearas sundes æt ende,

text: and þonne in þæt ēglond ūp gewītað collenferhþe; cēolas stondað bi staþe fæste strēame biwunden.
text_bare: and þonne in þæt eglond up gewitað collenferhþe; ceolas stondað bi staþe fæste streame biwunden.

text: Ðonne gewīciað wērigferhðe, faroðlācende, frēcnes ne wēnað.
text_bare: Ðonne gewiciað werigferhðe, faroðlacende, frecnes ne wenað.

text: On þām ēalonde ǣled weccað, hēah fyr ǣlað.
text_bare: On þam ealonde æled weccað, heah fyr ælað.

text: Hæleþ bēoþ on wynnum, rēonigmōde, ræste gelyste.
text_bare: Hæleþ beoþ on wynnum, reonigmode, ræste gelyste.

text: Þonne gefēleð fācnes cræftig þæt him þā fērend on fæste wuniaþ, wīc weardiað, wedres on luste, ðonne semninga on sealtne wǣg mid þā nōþe niþer gewīteþ, gārsecges gæst, grund gesēceð, and þonne in dēaðsele drence bifæsteð scipu mid scealcum.
text_bare: Þonne gefeleð facnes cræftig þæt him þa ferend on fæste wuniaþ, wic weardiað, wedres on luste, ðonne semninga on sealtne wæg mid þa noþe niþer gewiteþ, garsecges gæst, grund geseceð, and þonne in deaðsele drence bifæsteð scipu mid scealcum.

text: Swā bið scinnena þēaw, dēofla wīse, þæt hī drohtiende þurh dyrne meaht duguðe beswīcað, and on teosu tyhtaþ tilra dǣda, wēmað on willan, þæt hȳ wraþe sēcen,
text_bare: Swa bið scinnena þeaw, deofla wise, þæt hi drohtiende þurh dyrne meaht duguðe beswicað, and on teosu tyhtaþ tilra dæda, wemað on willan, þæt hy wraþe secen,

text: frōfre tō fēondum, oþþæt hy fæste ðǣr æt þām wǣrlogan wīc gecēosað.
text_bare: frofre to feondum, oþþæt hy fæste ðær æt þam wærlogan wic geceosað.

text: Þonne þæt gecnāweð of cwicsūsle flāh fēond gemāh, þætte fīra gehwylc hæleþa cynnes on his hringe biþ fæste gefēged, hē him feorgbona, þurh slīþen searo, siþþan weorþeð, wloncum and hēanum þe his willan hēr firenum fremmað; mid þām hē fǣringa, heoloþhelme biþeaht, helle sēceð, gōda gēasne, grundlēasne wylm under mistglōme, swā se micla hwæl se þe bisenceð sǣlīþende eorlas and ȳðmearas.
text_bare: Þonne þæt gecnaweð of cwicsusle flah feond gemah, þætte fira gehwylc hæleþa cynnes on his hringe biþ fæste gefeged, he him feorgbona, þurh sliþen searo, siþþan weorþeð, wloncum and heanum þe his willan her firenum fremmað; mid þam he færinga, heoloþhelme biþeaht, helle seceð, goda geasne, grundleasne wylm under mistglome, swa se micla hwæl se þe bisenceð sæliþende eorlas and yðmearas.

text: Hē hafað ōþre gecynd, wæterþisa wlonc, wrǣtlīcran gīen.
text_bare: He hafað oþre gecynd, wæterþisa wlonc, wrætlicran gien.

text: Þonne hine on holme hunger bysgað, and þone āglǣcan ǣtes lysteþ, ðonne se mereweard mūð ontȳneð,
text_bare: Þonne hine on holme hunger bysgað, and þone aglæcan ætes lysteþ, ðonne se mereweard muð ontyneð,

text: wīde weleras; cymeð wynsum stenc of his innoþe, þætte ōþre þurh þone, sǣfisca cynn, beswicen weorðaþ.
text_bare: wide weleras; cymeð wynsum stenc of his innoþe, þætte oþre þurh þone, sæfisca cynn, beswicen weorðaþ.

text: Swimmað sundhwate þǣr se swēta stenc ūt gewīteð.
text_bare: Swimmað sundhwate þær se sweta stenc ut gewiteð.

text: Hī þǣr in farað, unware weorude, oþþæt se wīda ceafl gefylled bið; þonne fǣringa ymbe þā herehūþe hlemmeð tōgædre grimme gōman.
text_bare: Hi þær in farað, unware weorude, oþþæt se wida ceafl gefylled bið; þonne færinga ymbe þa herehuþe hlemmeð togædre grimme goman.

text: Swā biþ gumena gehwām se þe oftost his unwærlīce, on þās lǣnan tīd, līf biscēawað: lǣteð hine beswīcan þurh swētne stenc, lēasne willan, þæt hē biþ leahtrum fāh wið Wuldorcyning.
text_bare: Swa biþ gumena gehwam se þe oftost his unwærlice, on þas lænan tid, lif bisceawað: læteð hine beswican þurh swetne stenc, leasne willan, þæt he biþ leahtrum fah wið Wuldorcyning.

text: Him se āwyrgda ongēan æfter hinsīþe helle ontȳneð, þām þe lēaslīce līces wynne ofer ferhðgereaht fremedon on unrǣd.
text_bare: Him se awyrgda ongean æfter hinsiþe helle ontyneð, þam þe leaslice lices wynne ofer ferhðgereaht fremedon on unræd.

text: Þonne se fǣcna in þām fæstenne gebrōht hafað, bealwes cræftig,
text_bare: Þonne se fæcna in þam fæstenne gebroht hafað, bealwes cræftig,

text: æt þām ādwylme, þā þe him on cleofiað, gyltum gehrodene, and ǣr georne his in hira līfdagum lārum hȳrdon, þonne he þā grimman gōman bihlemmeð, æfter feorhcwale, fæste tōgædre, helle hlinduru.
text_bare: æt þam adwylme, þa þe him on cleofiað, gyltum gehrodene, and ær georne his in hira lifdagum larum hyrdon, þonne he þa grimman goman bihlemmeð, æfter feorhcwale, fæste togædre, helle hlinduru.

text: Nāgon hwyrft nē swice, ūtsīþ ǣfre, þā þe þǣr in cumað, þon mā þe þā fiscas, faraðlācende, of þæs hwæles fenge hweorfan mōtan.
text_bare: Nagon hwyrft ne swice, utsiþ æfre, þa þe þær in cumað, þon ma þe þa fiscas, faraðlacende, of þæs hwæles fenge hweorfan motan.

text: Forþon is eallinga .
text_bare: Forþon is eallinga .

text: dryhtna Dryhtne, and ā dēoflum wiðsace wordum and weorcum, þæt wē Wuldorcyning gesēon mōton.
text_bare: dryhtna Dryhtne, and a deoflum wiðsace wordum and weorcum, þæt we Wuldorcyning geseon moton.

text: Uton ā sibbe tō him, on þās hwīlnan tīd, hǣlu sēcan, þæt wē mid swā lēofne in lofe mōtan tō wīdan feore wuldres nēotan.
text_bare: Uton a sibbe to him, on þas hwilnan tid, hælu secan, þæt we mid swa leofne in lofe motan to widan feore wuldres neotan.

text: Hȳrde ic secgan gēn bi sumum fugle wundorlīcne .
text_bare: Hyrde ic secgan gen bi sumum fugle wundorlicne .

text: fǣger þæt word þe gecwæð wuldres Ealdor: ‘In swā hwylce tiid swā gē mid trēowe tō mē on hyge hweorfað, and gē hellfirena sweartra geswīcað, swā ic symle tō ēow mid siblufan sōna gecyrre þurh milde mōd; gē bēoð mē siþþan
text_bare: fæger þæt word þe gecwæð wuldres Ealdor: ‘In swa hwylce tiid swa ge mid treowe to me on hyge hweorfað, and ge hellfirena sweartra geswicað, swa ic symle to eow mid siblufan sona gecyrre þurh milde mod; ge beoð me siþþan

text: torhte, tīrēadge, talade and rīmde, beorhte gebrōþor on bearna stǣl.’ Uton wē þȳ geornor Gode ōliccan, firene fēogan, friþes earnian, duguðe tō Dryhtne, þenden ūs dæg scīne, þæt swā æþelne eardwīca cyst in wuldres wlite wunian mōtan.
text_bare: torhte, tireadge, talade and rimde, beorhte gebroþor on bearna stæl.’ Uton we þy geornor Gode oliccan, firene feogan, friþes earnian, duguðe to Dryhtne, þenden us dæg scine, þæt swa æþelne eardwica cyst in wuldres wlite wunian motan.

text: Finit.
text_bare: Finit.
